note: Read from the code on September 26. Most of what the rules need exists in some form. Three things do not: a timed record for flights, trains, ferries and admissions; a count of visits per city; and feeds that report disruptions.
rows: Home city
Own city or another (02)
A home city on the profile (city, neighbourhood, how precise), set in the profile or by telling Chat. Never inferred.
People who never set it need a default (09).
Knowing a city
Whether another city still counts as familiar
History per place, not per city: visits marked or inferred from location, completed trips and their destinations, Life entries with dates.
No count per city. It is one aggregate, not a new system.
Where you are
Place card; leave-by; reaching the stay
Foreground location with accuracy, kept as one last position. Fresh under 2 min, recent under 15, then stale. Permission state is known.
The city is resolved only for Chat. Home needs it resolved from the last position.
Held things with times
Which object, and its window (04)
Plan items with start and end times and a booking reference; stays with dates and an optional check-in time; plan time windows.
No timed record for flights, trains, ferries or admissions, so 21’s pass and 20’s admission cannot go live from data yet.
What is current
It is now (rule A)
The plan state already knows the next item, the window open now and the next change. Trips know active or imminent by date.
Home does not read the open window to draw a live object yet.
Leave-by
When anything you travel to turns dark
A leave-by notification computes a departure time from straight-line distance.
An estimate, not routing. Good enough to open a window.
Offline
The still state and its “as of”
The app keeps the profile, trips and the Home stack on the phone for up to 12 hours, and knows the network state.
Home shows no “as of”. The stay’s door code is not in the saved set.
Disruption
Urgent (21.2)
Venue-closed swaps and weather rescue exist behind flags.
No transit, flight delay or gate feeds. Urgent stays drawn, not buildable.
fam: Familiar means the home city on the profile; anywhere else gets a place card. Works today. Wrong for someone back in a city they know well.
Also familiar: a city where Life holds several past visits or trips (three, say). Needs the one per-city count.
When no home city is set
Another city only when a trip names it as a destination, as with 19’s visitor. Otherwise no place card. Held things still go live everywhere.
qs: Reservations, gatherings and tickets turn dark 20 minutes before leave-by; flights at leave-by for the airport. Keep, or change?
B, falling back to C when there is no home city (recommended), or A alone?
The place card steps down when the last position is older than 15 minutes, the code’s own “recent”. Keep?
Build timed records for flights, trains, ferries and admissions before these can go live, or ship first with plan items and stays only?
The place card belongs to Places, drawn on Home. The dark Ticket goes to the shared package as a variant. Agree?
